profile.productDesc: Acme Analytics is a product-analytics tool for small SaaS teams. It answers 'which features do my paying customers actually use' without requiring an engineer to instrument every event by hand.
profile.icpDesc: Solo founders and teams of two to ten running a live B2B SaaS with paying customers. Technical enough to install a script, too busy to maintain a tracking plan. Usually outgrowing a spreadsheet or a free analytics tier and unsure which features drive retention.
disqualifiers: Agencies and consultants asking on behalf of clients
Anyone building their own analytics tool - a competitor, not a buyer
Marketing-attribution and ad-spend questions, which are a different problem
Pure implementation questions about a competitor's SDK with no evaluation intent
